description: This file defines the Affiliate model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, containing methods for managing customer affiliates such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving affiliate data, as well as handling affiliate reports.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Class for handling customer affiliate operations within the OpenCart system, such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving affiliate data, as well as managing reports.

methods.name: addAffiliate
methods.description: Creates a new affiliate record for a customer in the database, optionally initiates approval process if configured.

methods.name: editAffiliate
methods.description: Updates an existing affiliate record for a customer with new data.

methods.name: deleteAffiliate
methods.description: Deletes the affiliate record and related reports for a specific customer.

methods.name: getAffiliate
methods.description: Retrieves the affiliate record associated with a given customer ID.

methods.name: getAffiliateByTracking
methods.description: Retrieves affiliate information based on a unique tracking code.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Adds a new report entry for an affiliate visit or activity.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Removes all reports associated with a specific customer ID.
